label: panelIgnoresAvailability: Layer Style… opens the panel with no layer selected
find: if kind == nil || Self.catalog.availability("style.panel", on: self).why == nil { showStylePanel(kind) }

label: stubLooksLive: an item whose body is a stub is enabled
find: if case .notBuilt(_, let feature) = error { return "Not built yet (\(feature))." }

label: pasteWithoutACopy: Paste is enabled with nothing copied
find: guard let params = Self.styleMenuParams(id, pasted: pasted) else { return Self.nothingCopied }
replace: guard let params = Self.styleMenuParams(id, pasted: pasted) else { return nil }

label: panelOpensElsewhere: Layer Style… opens the panel at another section
windowlessItems: the style items turn on with no Halo window
find: guard let project else { return HaloMenuState.noWindow }
replace: guard let project else { return nil }
